title: Noise-Resilient Imaging through Coherence Filtering
summary: Noise is a significant challenge in imaging. Conventional intensity-based techniques mitigate noise through various filtering methods, but they often require prior knowledge of noise characteristics and struggle, especially under low-light conditions and with spatially structured noise. Quantum distillation provides enhanced noise rejection; however, its applicability is limited as it requires specialised illumination and substantial modifications to existing imaging setups.
